manifest.query: SELECT type,name,tbl_name,COALESCE(sql,'') FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','index','trigger','view') AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY type,name
manifest.normalization: Replace every maximal SQL whitespace run with one ASCII space and trim leading and trailing whitespace.
manifest.serialization: UTF-8 JSON Lines; one compact object per line; fields ordered object_type,name,table_name,sql; LF after every line; SHA-256 covers the exact JSONL bytes.

internalManifest.query: SELECT type,name,tbl_name,COALESCE(sql,'') FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','index','trigger','view') AND name LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY type,name
internalManifest.allowlist: The exact 37 sqlite_autoindex_* index objects generated by the frozen application-table constraints. sqlite_stat*, sqlite_sequence, or any other additional internal object fails closed.
internalManifest.serialization: The same normalized compact JSON Lines encoding as manifest; every allowed row has object_type=index and empty sql.

logicalManifest.tableAllowlist: All application tables in the exact canonical schema; an unlisted application table fails closed.
logicalManifest.tableOrdering: Ascending unsigned lexicographic order of raw UTF-8 table-name bytes.
logicalManifest.createTableSql: Manifest-normalized sqlite_schema CREATE TABLE SQL: replace every maximal SQL whitespace sequence with one ASCII space and trim leading and trailing whitespace.
logicalManifest.columnMetadata: PRAGMA table_xinfo ordered by ascending cid: cid, name, exact declared type, not-null flag, default presence and exact SQL text, primary-key ordinal, and hidden flag.
logicalManifest.rowOrdering: Sort by concatenated full encoded PRIMARY KEY values in primary-key ordinal order; only a table without a declared PRIMARY KEY uses the full encoded row as its fallback key; ties sort by the full encoded row.
logicalManifest.persistentOutput: Hashes and counts only: overall logical/business/primary-key/row SHA-256, per-table logical/business/primary-key/row SHA-256 where applicable, per-table row count, and total row count; never schema SQL, row or column values, primary keys, raw TEXT, or BLOB.

fixture.reason: Binary SQLite fixtures are deliberately excluded; tests construct the exact empty v10 database from the audited text manifest.

generation.postGenerationValidation: database::validate_user_database_read_only plus PRAGMA quick_check and PRAGMA foreign_key_check

migrationSourceOpen.walPreflight: The main header must be WAL mode and both existing WAL and SHM sidecars must pass frozen preflight before SQLite opens; immutable is forbidden because it would ignore WAL frames.
migrationSourceOpen.lifetimeGuard: Fixed-local non-reparse single-link handles for main/WAL/SHM and non-reparse directory handles remain pinned through proof, Backup API callback, commit, second-transaction closure, and final evidence comparison.

validationRule: Production validation compares every ordered normalized application manifest object and every frozen internal allowlist object. Neither manifest SHA-256 substitutes for complete object comparison; sqlite_% is never blanket-ignored. The fixture SHA-256 identifies only the deterministic empty fixture and never an arbitrary user database.
